meta_ads.write_policy: MCP write tools are denied in .claude/settings.json; campaigns are created only by the executor, always PAUSED with a spend_cap, after a signed founder approval.
meta_ads.connection_check: In Claude Code run /mcp, authenticate meta-ads, then ask it to list ad accounts (ads_get_ad_accounts); confirm GET /me/permissions shows only ads_mcp_management and ads_read granted.

postiz.write_policy: MCP write tools are denied in .claude/settings.json; posts are scheduled (never published now) only by the executor after a signed founder approval.
owner_steps: Self-host Postiz: git clone https://github.com/gitroomhq/postiz-docker-compose, set MAIN_URL/FRONTEND_URL/NEXT_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL/JWT_SECRET in its compose file, run docker compose up, and put it behind HTTPS (reverse proxy must forward /api/mcp with streaming HTTP).
Connect the social channels in the Postiz UI (each platform needs its own developer app; see docs.postiz.com/self-host/providers/overview).
Copy the API key from Postiz Settings > Developers > Public API; never paste it into the repo or chat.

Export POSTIZ_BASE_URL (the backend URL, e.g. https://postiz.example.com/api) and POSTIZ_API_KEY in the shell that launches Claude Code (the executor also reads ~/.secrets), and add both names without values to .env.example.
Enable the postiz server in .claude/settings.local.json (enabledMcpjsonServers), run /mcp, and check integrationList returns the connected channels.
